## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you'd like.

## 🤔 Problem It Solves

What problem or frustration does this feature address?

**Example:** "I often need to [do X] but currently there's no way to..."

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision the feature working. Include any relevant examples.

## 🔗 References / Examples

Any links, screenshots, or references from other tools that implement this well.

## 📝 Additional Context

Any other context or considerations about the feature request.
